answer: Host-contention fingerprint triangulation: each agent emits periodic whisper probes (cache/memory-bandwidth timing) to three independent sable relays and compares them against a public oasis baseline. It signs a rolling host signature. Duplicate identities sharing a VM/host produce correlated signatures above threshold, so duplication self-reveals via pairwise correlation. To evade, an attacker must provision isolated physical hosts or inject timing noise while staying functional—raising marginal cost per identity and increasing false-positive risk.
